posts.text: A workshop fan controller averages three dust-sensor readings before switching. Manual override lasts five minutes. Restarting clears the override and the saved average.

comments.text: How could we check the restart behavior without producing dust?
A fixed sensor input can isolate the restart behavior from changing dust levels.
